description: Every handler calls update_object and matches Ok(_), discarding the Option<O> that may contain server-modified fields. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires those fields to appear in the updated map. The MailBackend::update_object doc explicitly warns about this but all 8+ call sites ignore it anyway. Any backend that returns Some(O) from update_object will silently produce a non-conformant response. Trigger: backend returns Some(O) with a server-modified field (e.g. updatedAt) → client never sees the echo, believes the field was not changed.
title: update_object return value universally discarded — RFC 8620 §5.3 server-set echo broken
